prompts.weather:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production weather-icon sprite atlas for the iLMeteo educational website redesign.
Primary request: create a coherent family of SIX contemporary flat weather pictograms on a genuinely transparent alpha canvas. Landscape canvas 1536 by 1024 pixels, exactly THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows. Six equal square cells, one centered icon per cell; no visible grid. Leave each icon contained in the central 68 percent of its cell, with identical optical scale and generous transparent margins.
Exact cell order, left to right:
TOP ROW: 1. clear sunny day: orange sun disc and eight short rounded orange rays, no cloud; 2. mostly sunny day: the same orange sun visible behind ONE small pale blue cloud; 3. scattered clouds by day: the same orange sun partly covered by TWO overlapping larger pale blue clouds.
BOTTOM ROW: 4. mostly clear night: deep navy crescent moon behind ONE small pale blue cloud, absolutely no sun or orange rays; 5. scattered clouds by night: deep navy crescent moon partly covered by TWO larger pale blue clouds, absolutely no sun or orange rays; 6. light rain: TWO pale blue clouds and three separate deep blue raindrops underneath, absolutely no sun, moon or lightning.
Style/medium: crisp vector-like raster editorial iconography. Confident rounded silhouettes, consistent restrained deep navy #092b60 outlines, orange #dc5700 for the sun, pale icy blue #c9d9e9 cloud fills, action blue #064ec3 rain. Flat geometric yet friendly, visually related to a humanist sans-serif interface and a navy/orange sun-dot logo. Strong recognition at 48–60 pixels.
Constraints: one complete aligned atlas, transparent empty background, no text, labels, numbers, stars, mockup, tiles, frame, grid lines, gradient, texture, shadow, bevel, glow or watermark. Keep daylight and moonlight symbols semantically distinct. No extra icons.
prompts.weatherEdit:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached six-icon weather atlas.
Change ONLY the material rendering: REMOVE EVERY glow, halo, blur, drop shadow, smoky background, gradient and translucent haze. These are flat printed pictograms, not illuminated objects.
Keep the EXACT same six subjects, exact icon grid order, exact 1536x1024 canvas, 3 columns and 2 rows, positions and scale. Top row sunny, sun with one cloud, sun with two clouds. Bottom row crescent moon with one cloud, crescent moon with two clouds, two clouds with three raindrops. Preserve rounded outlines, sunny/cloudy distinctions and night/day semantics.
Render each shape with one UNIFORM SOLID opaque fill: sun orange #dc5700, contours and crescent navy #092b60, cloud pale blue #c9d9e9, rain blue #064ec3. No tonal variation inside any shape. Crisp antialiased edges only; zero haze around them. All space outside the six shapes MUST have alpha zero. Genuinely transparent background. No text, watermark, new shapes or decorations.
prompts.utility:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one production utility-icon sprite atlas for an iLMeteo website redesign.
Primary request: TWO simple contemporary UI pictograms, flat deep navy #092b60 only, on genuinely transparent alpha. Landscape canvas 1024 by 512 pixels, exactly TWO equal square cells in one row. No visible grid. Each icon is precisely centered within its cell, contained within the central 70 percent, equal optical scale.
LEFT CELL: one clear search magnifying glass, circular lens with an open transparent interior and a handle angled down-right.
RIGHT CELL: one clear switch-versions symbol: two parallel horizontal arrows, upper arrow points right and lower arrow points left. Open transparent space between them.
Style/medium: crisp vector-like raster, consistent moderately bold monoline stroke, round caps and joins, refined friendly geometric proportions. Must remain sharp and recognizable at 22–28 pixels.
Constraints: exactly two icons, one per cell, no text, labels, numbers, sun, clouds, decorative marks, grid, background tile, gradients, shadows, texture or watermark. Transparent background and transparent inside the lens.
